Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for touring our Westlake space yesterday. Attached is the site plan (site_plan_A1.pdf) and a quick AV rider we use for hybrid healthcare workshops. A few notes we wanted to confirm:

- Primary room: West Room B (capacity 80 classroom) with stage and two ceiling mics.
- Overflow: Adjacent breakout with direct HDMI feed to the main AV rack.
- Internet: 3 x 1Gb shared circuits, on-site wired drops available.
- Simulcast: We can stream to up to two endpoints; EchoTech is our preferred vendor for multi-room bridging.

Can you confirm expected attendee mix (onsite vs remote), any HIPAA constraints, and whether Crescent will require a private VLAN?

Best,

Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, Crescent Health Ops <ops@crescenthealth.com>

Subject: Re: Venue footprint and options for Sept 22 workshop

Thanks, Sofia — appreciated. Quick responses inline below and a few asks for EchoTech that are critical for our SLA with Crescent Health.

- Attendees: 55 onsite (executives + engineering leads), ~30 remote participants (external consultants + internal observers).
- HIPAA: Crescent requires no PHI to be transmitted during the session; all screenshared content that may contain PHI will be masked. They do require an audit log of session joins.
- Network: Yes — Crescent will request a dedicated customer VLAN and static IP blocks to tie back to their security team. Please confirm process to request VLAN at least 10 business days prior.

EchoTech asks (can you loop them in):
1) Simulcast failover: we need an automatic fallback path if the primary media bridge experiences packet loss — ideally a second media path routed via a separate ISP and second encoder.
2) Local recording: encrypted per-session recordings to be stored in a customer-controlled S3 bucket (they will provide access).
3) Latency SLO: end-to-end under 300ms for live room->remote participants where possible.

Please see attached a recommended AV spec (AV_rider_EchoTech.xlsx) for your planning.

Kimberly Park
Enterprise Events & GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

Hi all,

Thanks for the write-up. EchoTech can provide the following for the Sept 22 workshop:
- Primary bridge + secondary failover bridge (two independent public IPs on separate ISPs).
- Dual encoders (primary + hot spare) with automatic health-check and stream switchover in <5s when packet loss exceeds threshold.
- Encrypted local recording with S3 push (we will need the bucket write role ARN).
- Monitoring dashboard (RTT, packet loss, jitter) with 1-minute polling and a webhook for alerts to Redwood Ops.

Questions:
1) Who will own the webhook incident triage? (Redwood or Crescent?)
2) Can VenueWorks guarantee separate ISP uplinks for the two bridges? If not, we will stage a portable cellular uplink as additional redundancy.

Attaching our detailed failover diagram (simulcast_failover_diagram.png) and an updated AV rider (AV_rider_EchoTech.xlsx).

- EchoTech A/V Lead
